messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to production for commit abc123 at 2024-04-12T02:30:00Z. Requires approval from members with `prod-deploy` role. Canaries: service-a (5%), service-b (10%). /approve will trigger canary rollout.

alina: Holding — I tried to kick off the canary but the bot denied me: "insufficient permissions". Who currently has prod-deploy?

mark: We tightened that role last week after the incident. Only oncall + release-owners have it by default. Cross-team deploys need a JIT request via /request-jit.

jordan: I just ran `/request-jit --duration 30m --reason "hotfix: token-regen"` and got an automated deny: MFA not enrolled.

devops-bot: To enroll MFA, follow onboarding: https://id.company/internal/mfa — hardware key recommended. To request JIT with approval flow: `/request-jit @sasha --reason <reason>`.

sasha: I can approve but need confirmation this is a rollback-safe change. What's the exact release pin?

alina: We're deploying commit abc123 which pins runtime v2.4.0 and model v2024-03-11. If canary looks bad we may need to rollback to v2.3.9.

sasha: Ok. I can approve if Tariq or Mark signs off on DBA migrations and if Jordan enrolls MFA.

tariq: DB migration is a non-blocking noop for now — it's a schema comment only. I'm good with the canary. :+1:

jordan: MFA enrolled (Duo + YubiKey) — tested with `idctl auth test` and passed. Requesting JIT again.

jordan: `/request-jit @sasha --duration 30m --reason "hotfix: token-regen"` -> pending approval.

sasha: Approved. Granting JIT for 30m. Please run the deploy and monitor the canary windows.

alina: kicking off `/deploy prod --commit abc123 --canary` now. logs: ```
[2024-04-12T02:31:05Z] canary-start service-a 5% ok
[2024-04-12T02:31:10Z] canary-start service-b 10% ok
```

mark: Watching metrics. initial latencies look fine but see a small increase in p95 for service-b (from 180ms -> 260ms).

sasha: If p95 > 300ms for 2 consecutive windows rollback. Use `deploy rollback --to v2.3.9 --services service-b` and notify #incidents.

alina: Noted. If we need to pin the release to avoid auto-forwarding: set `release.pin: abc123` in the console or run `releasesctl pin abc123`.

deploy-bot: Canary completed for service-a. service-b still at 12% error budget usage, continuing.

mark: small surge appears correlated with a GPU quantization flag — sending a revert MR to flip `quantize_v2=false`.

alina: LGTM on revert MR, applying now.

deploy-bot: Revert MR merged; re-evaluating canary. service-b p95 dropping back to 190ms. Canary healthy.

sasha: Great. Since this was cross-team and required JIT, please add a short note in the release notes: "hotfix token regen + quantization flag revert — required JIT approval; prod deployers: sasha, mark, tariq".

jordan: Done — added notes and linked the MR. Closing JIT will auto-revoke deployer privileges.

alina: Thanks all. Rolling full deploy now. :shipit:
